import json, subprocess, time
def run(doc):
    t=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','-B','main.py'], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace/project')
    return p, time.time()-t

p, dt = run({"seed":"s","definitions":[["k","'na'"]],"timeout_ms":5,
